options.systemPromptTemplate:
Extract data from the supplier quotation text. Copy values exactly as written.
Remove thousand separators from numbers (5,664,000.00 -> 5664000).
For every *_text field, copy the exact sentence(s) from the document word for word.
If a value or clause is not clearly stated in the text, return null. Never guess or calculate.
If the quotation says no advance is needed, advance_payment_percentage is 0.
If the quotation has no late delivery clause at all, late_delivery_penalty_text and late_delivery_penalty_percent_per_week must be null and late_delivery_penalty_clause_present must be false.
If there is no separate VAT line, vat_percent and vat_amount must be null.
If TIN or BIN number is not written (for example 'details available on request'), return null for it.
